user.title: Sign in to Marvin
user.description:
Sign in to Marvin, then paste the address you land on.

1. **[Open the Marvin sign-in page]({authorize_url})** and sign in.

2. You will land on a Microsoft page titled **jwt.ms**. It may say it found no token — that is expected and does not mean anything went wrong.

3. Copy the whole address from your browser's address bar and paste it below. It contains `#code=...`.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Marvin again
reauth_confirm.description:
The saved session can no longer be renewed.

**[Sign in to Marvin again]({authorize_url})**, then copy the whole address of the **jwt.ms** page you land on and paste it below.

error.no_code: No authorization code found in that address. Copy the whole thing from the address bar, including everything after `#`.
error.invalid_code: That code was rejected. Codes are single-use and expire quickly — start again from the sign-in link above.
error.no_refresh_token: Sign-in succeeded but no refresh token was issued, so Home Assistant could not stay signed in.
error.state_mismatch: That URL came from a different sign-in attempt. Start again from the sign-in link above and paste the URL it produces.

abort.already_configured: This house is already set up.
abort.no_houses: No houses were found on this Marvin account.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: That Marvin account cannot see this house. Sign in with the account this house was originally set up with.

init.title: Dry-contact fallback
init.description:
Marvin's windows have momentary dry contacts that work with no network at all. If you have wired them to switch entities, Home Assistant can use them when the Marvin cloud is unreachable.

This is entirely optional — leave it empty and nothing will ever pulse a relay.

Choose a window to configure.

window.title: Dry contacts for {window}
window.description:
Pick the switch entity wired to each contact, and the position that contact drives the sash to.

The percentages are pre-filled from the window's own configuration, but the mapping between those settings and the physical terminals is undocumented — **check them against your wiring**. Fire one relay channel and see where the sash ends up.

Leave a row blank if that contact is not wired. A 4-wire run typically has close plus three open positions and no stop.

data.pulse_duration: Pulse duration in seconds (0 if the switch pulses itself)
data.notify_on_switchover: Notify when falling back to dry contacts

data_description.contact_sensor: Without one, position and open/closed report as unknown while the cloud is down. Home Assistant will not guess.
data_description.pulse_duration: Contacts are edge-triggered, so this only has to be long enough for the relay to actuate.

abort.no_sashes: No windows with a movable sash were found.
abort.entry_not_loaded: The integration is not currently loaded. Fix its setup (or finish signing in again) and retry.
